section: 3.4 Hardness to variation: two notions, honestly separated (R2; repairs F2)
claim: The contract-relative preservation lemma (H) says nothing about any explanation's content and must not be cited as a formalization of hard to vary.
Capability implies physical possibility, and the converse is not claimed.

section: 8.3 Admissible enabling conditions, formalized (R3; repairs F1/F3)
claim: An enabling condition that delivers the target achievement itself is not admissible for a capacity claim.
A counterexample may not be absorbed by re-graining after the fact; a re-grain that dissolves a counterexample is a new constitutive proposal that must be defended as such.
